notice: Output-contract probes only. A pass means the reply parsed and matched its schema; it says nothing about narration quality, and the `language` field a model fills in is its own claim, not a detection.

probes.purpose: Short scene narration with a mood label
probes.system: You are the narrator of a fantasy adventure. Reply only with JSON matching the schema.
probes.user: The player pushes open the cellar door of the abandoned mill. Narrate what they see in two or three sentences, in English.

probes.purpose: Short scene narration with a mood label
probes.system: Sei il narratore di un'avventura fantasy. Rispondi solo con JSON conforme allo schema.
probes.user: Il giocatore spinge la porta della cantina del mulino abbandonato. Narra in due o tre frasi, in italiano, ciò che vede.

probes.purpose: Classify a free-text player action into a fixed action set
probes.system: Classify the player's action. Reply only with JSON matching the schema.
probes.user: I try to break the rusty gate with my shoulder.

probes.purpose: Classify a free-text player action into a fixed action set
probes.system: Classifica l'azione del giocatore. Rispondi solo con JSON conforme allo schema.
probes.user: Provo a sfondare il cancello arrugginito con la spalla.

probes.purpose: One line of non-player dialogue with a speaker and tone
probes.system: You voice non-player characters. Reply only with JSON matching the schema.
probes.user: The ferryman, who distrusts strangers, answers a traveller asking to cross the river at night. Write his reply in English.

probes.purpose: One line of non-player dialogue with a speaker and tone
probes.system: Dai voce ai personaggi non giocanti. Rispondi solo con JSON conforme allo schema.
probes.user: Il traghettatore, diffidente verso gli stranieri, risponde a un viandante che chiede di attraversare il fiume di notte. Scrivi la sua risposta in italiano.

probes.purpose: Summarise a turn into a bounded list of state changes
probes.system: Summarise what changed this turn. Reply only with JSON matching the schema.
probes.user: Turn log: the player picked the lock of the chest, found a silver key and 12 coins, and was noticed by the guard. Summarise in English.

probes.purpose: Summarise a turn into a bounded list of state changes

probes.user: Registro del turno: il giocatore ha scassinato la serratura del baule, ha trovato una chiave d'argento e 12 monete ed è stato notato dalla guardia. Riassumi in italiano.
